summary: Harden account-runtime regular-file inode checks, integer overflow, URI host/colon segments, and regex anchors

delivery.outcome: Enforce lstat+fstat (st_dev, st_ino) regular-file identity, relative ancestor symlink rejection, and max_bytes integer bounds in read_regular_utf8; reject huge-integer overflow and lone UTF-16 surrogates in strict_loads; block host '..', invalid origin ports, backslash/query/fragment/DEL, and colon-delimited '..' segments in validate_safe_uri_segments; detect open implicit object schemas in assert_closed_schema; anchor all regexes with \A...\Z across account_primitives.py, conformance.py, and service_access_conformance.py; add regression tests; and close merged ticket-008.
nonGoals: Do not modify frozen schemas or grammars

architecture.decision: Add compile_anchored_pattern, lstat+fstat inode identity and relative ancestor symlink checks, strict UTF-8 and numeric leaf finiteness checks, authority/port/colon URI segment validation, and implicit-object closed-schema checks in standard/account_primitives.py, and compile schema patterns with \A...\Z anchors in conformance.py and service_access_conformance.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch commit via protected PR delivery.
